title: In vivo evaluation of drug lead candidates by intravenous continuous infusion
protocol: Grow _S. aureus_ MB 2865 overnight with aeration in TSB medium.
Harvest and wash bacteria with fresh TSB.
Dilute bacteria to achieve an inoculum of 4 x 10^3 CFU/mL in 5% hog gastric mucin.
Infect mice intraperitoneally using 0.5 mL of the diluted bacterial solution.
Attach 0.5 inch hollow connectors to external JVC catheter sections.
Harness mice to counter-balance arm inside a mouse cage.
Connect fluid-primed PE 20 tubings attached to individual syringes on the infusion pump to mice through the connector.
Initiate infusion pump for 24 hours at a flow rate of 0.1 mL/hour.
Take blood samples by tail vein during infusion to determine serum drug concentration.
Aseptically remove kidneys and homogenize them.
Plate serial dilutions of kidney homogenates on Mannitol plates.
